row.evidence: Remote's SCIM 2.0 API only lists and reads users and groups, and Okta's Remote.com app is described as "a one-way integration from Remote to Okta" with Remote as the system of record, so IdPs cannot provision users into Remote over SCIM.
row.notes: Status changed from gated to none. June read 'SCIM publicly documented' as provisioning gated to Enterprise/Scale, but the documented SCIM 2.0 API (gateway.remote.com/v1/scim/v2) is read-only (GET Users, GET Groups/departments): it exposes Remote as an HR source for IdPs, not as a provisioning target. Okta's catalogue app is HR-driven (Remote to Okta), not inbound. The June 'Enterprise/Scale' plan gate had no first-party source and is dropped. Prices: EOR shows $699/employee/mo; June's $599 annual figure appears only in the page's embedded data, not in visible text, so it is not recorded; Contractor Management $29/contractor/mo; Contractor Management Plus $99. SAML 2.0 SSO exists company-wide but its plan is not published. Admin (Company Manager) users can be created, invited and deleted through the Remote API with a customer API token. idp.generic is set false because the SCIM endpoint cannot create or change users.

operations.notes: Only GET /v1/scim/v2/Users, /Users/{id}, /Groups and /Groups/{id} are listed in the API reference; write operations are marked false because the IdP integration is documented as one-way from Remote.

filtering.notes: Operators eq, ne, co, sw, ew, pr, lt, le, gt, ge.

rate_limits.text: Remote API: 300 requests per minute per company.

limitations.text: Read-only SCIM: Remote is the system of record; IdPs read employees from Remote rather than provisioning into it.

scim.notes: scim.available is false for inbound provisioning; a read-only outbound SCIM 2.0 API exists.

capabilities.notes: Covers Company Manager (admin) users; employee accounts follow employment onboarding.

endpoints.purpose: Create and invite a Company Manager

rate_limits.text: 300 requests per minute per company (not per token).

okta.notes: OIN page marks SCIM, Create and Update, but provisioning is HR-driven from Remote into Okta (one-way); SAML is not checked. It does not provision accounts into Remote, so idp.okta is 'none'.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial at remote-com-tutorial or remote-tutorial (404).

fallbacks.other_sync: Remote acts as HR source of truth (read-only SCIM and Okta HR-driven import)
